Attached: 1 image

Unread mail is loud. That doesn't make it your hardest task.

The inbox, or a big project name like “the report,” tends to grab the top spot because it's visible. The slice that would move your week stays untouched.

Before you open mail, write one small, finishable slice on a card: “Outline section 2,” not “the report.” If finishing it makes next week easier and you've been dodging it, it goes first.

One card. One bite. Then the inbox.

#productivity
